design_condition: The quiet building is placed within the orthogonal pool complex, with an almost symmetrical entrance facing the canal and a long terrace extending toward the outdoor pool.

positive.statement: The project develops a clear concept with high qualities in terms of floor plans and external appearance.

position.rationale: Elongated orthogonal mass and layered elevations support a coherent overall concept.

positive.statement: The centrally arranged access area is clear, spacious, and convincingly designed as a control point.

position.rationale: The access point is constrained to the centered entrance edge facing the canal.

positive.statement: The restaurant with its full-length terrace and view of the outdoor pool is very attractive.

position.rationale: The long terrace is approximated along the building’s pool-facing side.

positive.statement: The external expression is very appealing, with a fine and systematic facade structure.

position.rationale: Regularly sampled facade bands are clearly visible in the elevations.

positive.statement: The project authors succeeded in developing a clear concept valued as an outstanding contribution.

position.rationale: The project-wide judgment is anchored to the broad elongated building envelope.

negative.statement: The catering area is not optimally organized for full operation.

position.rationale: Interior catering space is not distinguishable, so it is estimated within the front-left building zone.

negative.statement: The strong spatial separation between the swimming pool and the arcade is criticized.

position.rationale: The central rectangular arrangement provides the closest visible proxy for pool and arcade separation.

negative.statement: The main passage and the parallel passage past hairdryers and showers do not work operationally or for bathers.

position.rationale: Circulation routes are internal and indistinct, estimated along the central longitudinal zone.

negative.statement: The superficially clear division of the room program becomes complicated and inflexible in detail.

position.rationale: The critique concerns internal subdivision, approximated within the east half of the building.

negative.statement: There are not enough toilets on the hall floor, and the route to swimming equipment is too long.

position.rationale: Hall-floor functions are estimated near the entrance-side edge and lower circulation route.

negative.statement: The basement storage and disposal rooms are very inconvenient, while the delivery route is too prominent and too narrow.

position.target: basement storage, disposal, and delivery route
position.rationale: Basement service functions are approximated at a low level along the east delivery side.

negative.statement: The workshop inside the building is unusable because it has no daylight.

position.rationale: The interior workshop is absent as a distinct feature and estimated near the front-left envelope.

negative.statement: The treatment of topography in the access area with parking facilities is considered unmanaged.

position.rationale: Access and parking are approximated outside the canal-facing entrance edge.

negative.statement: The interior is too bulky and lacks the subtlety and spatial character sought for by a bather.

position.rationale: The elongated, layered volume visibly supports the critique of bulk and limited spatial subtlety.

negative.statement: Expected investment and operating costs are in the upper third because of the relatively large volume and above-average maintenance costs.

position.rationale: Cost and maintenance performance have no useful geometric location.
